skill.name: launch-strategy
skill.description: Plan phased product launches, feature announcements, Product Hunt campaigns, and post-launch marketing across owned, rented, and borrowed channels.
skill.summary: Guides phased product launches from early access through post-launch momentum.
skill.author: sickn33

static_findings.snippet: Sent a free e-ink display to YouTuber Snazzy Labs—not a paid sponsorship, just hoping he'd like it.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 90 describes sending a product sample to a YouTube reviewer as a launch case study. It does not instruct system probing, data collection, credential access, or reconnaissance activity.

content.value_statement: Launches often stall when teams rely on one announcement. This skill helps plan phased campaigns, channel strategy, Product Hunt launches, and post-launch momentum.
actual_capabilities: Explains owned, rented, and borrowed channel planning.
Structures launches into internal, alpha, beta, early access, and full launch phases.
Provides Product Hunt preparation, launch day, and follow-up guidance.
Recommends post-launch education, comparison pages, demos, and email reinforcement.
Supplies launch checklists and planning questions.
limitations: Does not create campaign assets, designs, videos, or email copy by itself.
Does not validate legal, platform policy, or advertising compliance.
Does not replace market research, analytics setup, or product readiness review.
Recommendations need audience, timeline, and channel data from the user.

use_cases.title: Plan a First Public Launch
use_cases.description: Create a practical launch path from early validation to general availability.

use_cases.title: Announce a Major Feature
use_cases.description: Choose announcement channels, timing, and follow-up tactics for an important release.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Product Hunt Campaign
use_cases.description: Organize listing assets, supporter outreach, launch day engagement, and post-launch capture.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a launch for [product or feature]. My audience is [audience], my timeline is [timeline], and my current channels are [channels].

prompt_templates.title: Map Launch Channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Use owned, rented, and borrowed channels to design a launch channel plan for [product]. Include priorities, risks, and conversion paths.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Product Hunt Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Product Hunt launch plan for [product]. Cover pre-launch preparation, launch day tasks, supporter outreach, and follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Phase Launch System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a phased launch strategy for [product]. Include internal, alpha, beta, early access, full launch, and post-launch momentum work.

output_examples.input: I am launching a SaaS analytics tool in six weeks.
output_examples.output: A phased plan with internal testing, beta invites, Product Hunt preparation, launch day tasks, and post-launch onboarding.

output_examples.input: We are releasing a major feature to existing customers.
output_examples.output: A focused announcement plan using email, in-app messages, blog content, social posts, and feedback collection.

output_examples.input: I want to keep momentum after launch week.
output_examples.output: A post-launch plan with onboarding emails, comparison pages, interactive demos, roundup mentions, and the next announcement cycle.

best_practices: Start with owned channels so launch attention can convert into direct relationships.
Match each launch phase to product readiness and feedback goals.
Plan post-launch adoption before the public announcement goes live.
anti_patterns: Treating launch as a single day instead of a phased campaign.
Relying only on Product Hunt or social platforms for demand.
Pitching influencers without audience fit, value, or a clear conversion path.

faq.question: What types of launches does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports new products, feature releases, early access campaigns, beta launches, Product Hunt launches, and product updates.

faq.question: Can it help before the product is fully ready?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes internal, alpha, beta, and early access phases for controlled learning before full availability.

faq.question: Does it write launch copy?
faq.answer: It focuses on launch strategy and planning. It can guide messaging needs, but copywriting is not the main capability.

faq.question: Does it require an existing audience?
faq.answer: No. It helps identify owned, rented, and borrowed channels based on the user's current audience and constraints.

faq.question: Is Product Hunt required?
faq.answer: No. Product Hunt is optional and should be used only when it fits the audience and launch goals.

faq.question: What information should users provide?
faq.answer: Users should provide the product, audience, timeline, channels, launch history, and Product Hunt plans if relevant.
